key: "PULSE-05B"
en: "PULSE-05B"
ja: 「PULSE-05B」

key: I wasn't expecting anyone to actually come here.
en: I wasn't expecting anyone to actually come here.
ja: まさか、ここまで本当に誰か来るとは思ってなかった。

key: But that's fine, I guess.
en: But that's fine, I guess.
ja: でも、まあいいか。

key: My name's Taka. What's yours?
en: My name's Taka. What's yours?
ja: 僕はタカ。君の名前は?

key: \PN?
en: \PN?
ja: \PN?

key: ...Thought so.
en: ...Thought so.
ja: ……やっぱりね。

key: I assume you're looking for this thing, right?
en: I assume you're looking for this thing, right?
ja: これを探してるんだよね?

key: TAKA: This Tangrowth has caused a lot of damage.
en: TAKA: This Tangrowth has caused a lot of damage.
ja: タカ: このモジャンボが、たくさんの被害を出したんだ。

key: All the destruction in Jasper is because of it.
en: All the destruction in Jasper is because of it.
ja: ジャスパーで起きた破壊は、全部こいつのせいだよ。

key: The PULSE it's linked to has made this Tangrowth take lives, homes, and much more than that.
en: The PULSE it's linked to has made this Tangrowth take lives, homes, and much more than that.
ja: こいつがつながってるPULSEのせいで、このモジャンボは命も、家も、それ以上のものも奪ってきた。

key: TAKA: But, you know...
en: TAKA: But, you know...
ja: タカ: でも、さ……

key: I'm sure it never wanted this either.
en: I'm sure it never wanted this either.
ja: きっと、こいつだってこんなこと、望んでなかったはずだ。

key: Mutated, morphed, and altogether mangled,
en: Mutated, morphed, and altogether mangled,
ja: 変異して、姿を変えられて、めちゃくちゃにされて、

key: This is just the life that was chosen for it.
en: This is just the life that was chosen for it.
ja: これが、こいつに選ばれた人生ってだけなんだ。

key: To be honest, I just want to let it go.
en: To be honest, I just want to let it go.
ja: 正直に言うと、僕はただ、こいつを解放してあげたい。

key: Tell it, "You've done enough,
en: Tell it, "You've done enough,
ja: こう伝えたい、「もう十分がんばったよ、

key: You're free to do whatever you please now."
en: You're free to do whatever you please now."
ja: これからは、好きにしていいんだよ」って。

key: TAKA: ...Unfortunately, I can't do that.
en: TAKA: ...Unfortunately, I can't do that.
ja: タカ: ……でも、残念ながら、それはできないんだ。

key: After all, I'm with Team Meteor.
en: After all, I'm with Team Meteor.
ja: だって、僕はチームメテオの一員だから。

key: Surround him.
en: Surround him.
ja: 彼を取り囲め。

key: Surround her.
en: Surround her.
ja: 彼女を取り囲め。

key: Surround them.
en: Surround them.
ja: 彼らを取り囲め。

key: TAKA: Sorry about this.
en: TAKA: Sorry about this.
ja: タカ: ごめんね、こんなことになって。

key: By the way, one of my orders is to eliminate you, so don't take it personally or anything, all right?
en: By the way, one of my orders is to eliminate you, so don't take it personally or anything, all right?
ja: ちなみに、君を排除するのも命令のひとつだから、あんまり個人的に受け取らないでほしいな、いい?

key: HEATHER: I don't think so!
en: HEATHER: I don't think so!
ja: ヘザー: そうはさせないわ!

key: HEATHER: Now that I'm here, you better believe you're in for a world of pain!
en: HEATHER: Now that I'm here, you better believe you're in for a world of pain!
ja: ヘザー: あたしが来たからには、覚悟しといた方がいいわよ、痛い目に遭わせてやるから!

key: TAKA: ...Sorry, who are you?
en: TAKA: ...Sorry, who are you?
ja: タカ: ……ごめん、君は誰?

key: HEATHER: The name's Heather, magical maiden of the wind and hero to all!
en: HEATHER: The name's Heather, magical maiden of the wind and hero to all!
ja: ヘザー: 名前はヘザー、風の魔法乙女にして、みんなのヒーローよ!

key: TAKA: ...Riiiight...
en: TAKA: ...Riiiight...
ja: タカ: ……そ、そうなんだ……

key: METEOR: As if a little girl's gonna do anything about it!
en: METEOR: As if a little girl's gonna do anything about it!
ja: メテオ団員: 小娘一人に、何ができるってんだ!

key: HEATHER: Wanna bet?
en: HEATHER: Wanna bet?
ja: ヘザー: 賭ける?

key: I can beat up all three of you at once!
en: I can beat up all three of you at once!
ja: あんたたち三人まとめて、ぶちのめしてやるわ!

key: METEOR: We'd like to see you try!
en: METEOR: We'd like to see you try!
ja: メテオ団員: やれるもんならやってみろ!

key: HEATHER: Well, okay! Don't say I didn't warn you!
en: HEATHER: Well, okay! Don't say I didn't warn you!
ja: ヘザー: はいはい! 警告はしたからね!

key: METEOR: Wh-what the hell kind of kid has a Salamence?!
en: METEOR: Wh-what the hell kind of kid has a Salamence?!
ja: メテオ団員: な、なんだこのガキ、ボーマンダ持ってんのか!?

key: HEATHER: What's the matter?
en: HEATHER: What's the matter?
ja: ヘザー: どうしたの?

key: You aren't suddenly afraid of a little girl, are you?!
en: You aren't suddenly afraid of a little girl, are you?!
ja: まさか、急に小さい女の子が怖くなったとか、そんなんじゃないでしょうね!?

key: Hey, \PN, these guys have really ticked me off, so I'll deal with them!
en: Hey, \PN, these guys have really ticked me off, so I'll deal with them!
ja: ねえ、\PN、こいつらマジでムカつくから、あたしがやっつけとくわ!

key: I'm leaving the Tangrowth to you!
en: I'm leaving the Tangrowth to you!
ja: モジャンボの方は、あんたに任せた!

key: TAKA: ...Well, I guess this is fine.
en: TAKA: ...Well, I guess this is fine.
ja: タカ: ……まあ、これでいいのかもね。

key: Let's see what you can do.
en: Let's see what you can do.
ja: 君の実力、見せてもらうよ。

key: Well, I tried.
en: Well, I tried.
ja: まあ、やるだけは　やりました

key: TAKA: So that's it, is it...
en: TAKA: So that's it, is it...
ja: タカ: そう、これで終わりか……

key: What a shame.
en: What a shame.
ja: 残念だな。

key: Perhaps I shouldn't say this, but there's one last Tangrowth up in the Beryl Ward.
en: Perhaps I shouldn't say this, but there's one last Tangrowth up in the Beryl Ward.
ja: こんなこと言うべきじゃないかもしれないけど、ベリル区にもう一体、モジャンボが残ってるんだ。

key: It would be even more of a shame if something were to happen to that one too.
en: It would be even more of a shame if something were to happen to that one too.
ja: あっちにも何かあったら、もっと残念なことになるだろうな。

key: TAKA: ...Ah, and there's that.
en: TAKA: ...Ah, and there's that.
ja: タカ: ……ああ、それとさ。

key: HEATHER: \PN, I think this whole place is going to collapse!
en: HEATHER: \PN, I think this whole place is going to collapse!
ja: ヘザー: \PN、ここ全体、崩れそうな気がする!

key: Quick, hop on! I'll get us out of here!
en: Quick, hop on! I'll get us out of here!
ja: 早く、乗って! ここから連れ出してあげる!

key: HEATHER: Salamence, it's take-off time!
en: HEATHER: Salamence, it's take-off time!
ja: ヘザー: ボーマンダ、離陸の時間よ!

key: METEOR: Sir, did you notice?!
en: METEOR: Sir, did you notice?!
ja: メテオ団員: 隊長、気づきましたか!?

key: That girl-- she was wearing a Ruby Ring!
en: That girl-- she was wearing a Ruby Ring!
ja: あの女――ルビーのゆびわをつけてましたよ!

key: TAKA: Oh, really?
en: TAKA: Oh, really?
ja: タカ: へえ、そうなんだ?

key: Well, whatever.
en: Well, whatever.
ja: まあ、いいや。

key: Pack it up; we're due to move up to Rhodochrine.
en: Pack it up; we're due to move up to Rhodochrine.
ja: 撤収だ。ロドクラインに移動する予定だからね。

key: A hole in the ground shoots directly below.
en: A hole in the ground shoots directly below.
ja: 地面の穴は、真下へと続いている。

key: Jump?
en: Jump?
ja: 飛び降りますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
